def render(self) -> str:
    parts = [
        f"class {self.name}:",
    ]
    
    # Add attributes in alphabetical order
    for stub in sorted(self.attribute_stubs, key=lambda stub: stub.name):
        parts.append(f"    {stub.render()}")
    
    # Add methods in alphabetical order
    for _, stub in sorted(self.function_stubs.items()):
        rendered = stub.render(prefix="    ")
        # Handle classmethod and staticmethod decorators
        if "classmethod" in rendered:
            # Extract the method part and add the decorator
            method_part = rendered.split("\n")[-1]
            parts.append(method_part)
        elif "staticmethod" in rendered:
            # Extract the method part and add the decorator
            method_part = rendered.split("\n")[-1]
            parts.append(method_part)
        else:
            parts.append(rendered)
    
    return "\n".join(parts)
